mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
UPDATE transactions t JOIN approval_requests ar ON ar.transaction_id = t.transaction_id SET t.status = 'CANCELED' WHERE ar.status = 'PENDING' AND ar.expired_at <= NOW() AND t.status = 'HELD'
UPDATE transactions SET status = 'CANCELED' WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND status = 'HELD'
